retention_days.title: Retention Days
retention_days.description: Days of logs retained; 0 means nothing is eligible.

cutoff.title: Cutoff
cutoff.description: Records older than this timestamp would be deleted; null when retention is unlimited.

records.title: Records
records.description: Number of log records that would be deleted.

payload_bytes.title: Payload Bytes
payload_bytes.description: Total archived payload size of those records, in bytes.

oldest_event_time.title: Oldest Event Time
oldest_event_time.description: Timestamp of the oldest record that would be deleted.

newest_purged_event_time.title: Newest Purged Event Time
newest_purged_event_time.description: Timestamp of the newest record that would be deleted.

total_records.title: Total Records
total_records.description: Total log records currently in the archive.

records_kept.title: Records Kept
records_kept.description: Records that would remain after the purge.

database_bytes.title: Database Bytes
database_bytes.description: On-disk size of the SQLite archive including its WAL; null on server backends.

reclaimable_bytes.title: Reclaimable Bytes
reclaimable_bytes.description: Estimated disk space the purge and its compaction would return to the filesystem, in bytes.

compaction_mode.title: Compaction Mode
compaction_mode.description: How the space is reclaimed: 'incremental' (cheap, the Log Archiver keeps running), 'rebuild' (a one-off full rebuild of the database file), or 'server-managed'.

compaction_stops_archiver.title: Compaction Stops Archiver
compaction_stops_archiver.description: Whether reclaiming the space requires stopping the Log Archiver instances for the duration.

compaction_blocked.title: Compaction Blocked
compaction_blocked.description: Why the space cannot be reclaimed on this run — most often not enough free disk to rebuild into. The purge itself still runs.

free_disk_bytes.title: Free Disk Bytes
free_disk_bytes.description: Free space on the volume holding the archive; null when it cannot be measured.

schema.title: PurgePreviewResponse
schema.description: What a purge would delete if it ran right now.

503.description: The log database could not be read
